headline: CONTRA's loop now hits like a cabinet
lede: Clear stage 1 and the arcade used to hand it back with a small gold tag. Now LOOP n slams across the screen on wipe bars while the world holds two quiet beats, the life heads flash gold for the banked courtesy, the jungle sky reddens and the guns pitch up as the passes stack — and the attract demo teaches the whole trick before you ever clear the gate.

notes.text: #2902 shipped: LOOP banner interstitial, gold bank-flash, ~2 s quiet hold before stage 2 starts moving, red-shifted sky at loop 3+, hot muzzle flashes from loop 2, per-pass voice rise (+6%, capped), LOOP tag plated for phone scale.

Every heat cue is derived from gs.loop — palette and pitch only, zero rng, hash-clean; loopK stays the only thing that makes the stage faster. 10 new sim pins + 5 new browser legs say so, and two new mutants (loop-blind, voice-flat) die on the named harm.
Bug found mid-pass: CONTRA's attract demo froze on its first end frame forever (a double demoHold assignment). It cycles again now — which is what lets it run a LOOP 2 teaching pass with the banner.

jalfern.com's proxy edge caches negative asset responses for a few minutes after each deploy — production verification belongs on retrogames-psi.vercel.app (and Contra lives in a lazy chunk, not the shell bundle).
